title: Faded portrait
description: Tinted, faded, grainy and scratched. Once the tones are restored, OpenCV finds far more of the real scratches, so the repair covers them.

title: Real 1925 portrait
description: A real faded, tinted print. The blacks have lifted too, so the agent treats the tint as ageing: colour first, then tones.

title: Real 1972 colour slide
description: A real dye-faded slide with a magenta cast, but its blacks are intact. Is that ageing or the real light? The agent asks you.

title: Real 1942 scratched print
description: A wide, curved scratch the detector misses, so the agent leaves it. Click “Touch up damage”, paint over it, and watch the agent repair and check it.

title: Badly damaged cat
description: Dense scratches and dust over a large area. The agent won't invent that much of the photo without your approval.

title: Undamaged control
description: Nothing wrong with this one. A good restorer leaves it alone, and so does ReVive.
